title: Bounded-above complexes with pseudo-coherent cohomology are pseudo-coherent
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $K\in D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Suppose there exists an integer $b$ with $H^i(K)=0$ for every $i>b$, and for every integer $i$ the $R$-module $H^i(K)$, regarded as a complex concentrated in degree zero, is pseudo-coherent [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex]. Then $K$ is pseudo-coherent [def-pc-ring-pseudo-coherent-complex].
